target.purpose: Make query intent immutable and gate declared downstream reuse against the exact purpose, column boundary and accepted purpose-to-use policy.
target.central_bottleneck: If a query ID can be rebound or downstream reuse is not tied to the exact intent and policy version, earlier audit decisions can become meaningless even though the identifier stays unchanged.
success: Query IDs cannot be rebound to a different purpose/column/SQL intent.
Malformed intent and use dimensions fail closed.
Downstream columns must be a subset of registered query columns.
Downstream use type must be permitted by the intent purpose policy.
Policy, intent and chained event identities are receipt-bound.
No SQL execution or external policy enforcement is implied.

invariants: reuse columns cannot exceed registered query columns

donors.boundary: claim fence may later consume immutable query-intent fingerprints; no exercised integration exists yet

evolution.composition_gate: Do not expose query-intent fingerprints to the claim fence as integrated evidence until receipt-level composition is executable and reproduced.

nonclaims: not a production Snowflake governance service
no SQL execution or query-result verification
no external actor authentication or Snowflake RLS enforcement
